`final class GradientShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`ShaderProgram`](/reference/shaders/shaderprogram/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GradientShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/GradientShader.java)

The shader of linear gradients, which colors what is drawn along a line between two stops.

## Description

[`Color.bind`](/reference/drawing/color/#Color-method-bind) and [`ColorGradient.use`](/reference/drawing/colorgradient/#ColorGradient-method-use) use it for a gradient color; you rarely call it yourself.

## Method details

<a id="GradientShader-method-use"></a>

### use

`void use(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, Color startColor, Color endColor, Runnable runnable, BoundingBox canvas)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Runs `runnable` with the gradient from `startColor` at `startPoint` to `endColor` at `endPoint`, points on 1 of `canvas`, then restores the previous shader.

`void use(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, Color startColor, Color endColor, boolean hasTexture, Runnable runnable, BoundingBox canvas)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Same as the other `use`; if `hasTexture` is `true`, the gradient multiplies the bound texture instead of replacing it.
